scenario.name: r-cw-delegate-child-live-producer
scenario.description: Live child identity, child-bound continue_work schedule, and distinct child hop-two completion.

invocation.promptTemplate: Child nonce {{nonce}}. Call continue_work exactly once with reason={{reason}} and delaySeconds={{delaySeconds}}. After its tool result reports scheduled, reply exactly CHILD-HOP1-SCHEDULED {{nonce}}. On the successor wake reply exactly CHILD-HOP2-COMPLETE {{nonce}}. Do not mutate files.

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-run-flow-identity
expectedReceipts.description: TaskFlow-backed child session, initial run, task, and flow identities.

expectedReceipts.name: child-bound-schedule-and-hop-two
expectedReceipts.description: continue_work tool start/result is bound to the initial child run; a distinct run in that child session starts, emits the nonce output, and settles.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Fresh trace ID for the child continue_work schedule and fire.

review.notes: Never infer child creation or completion from sentinel text. Structured task, session, run, flow, tool-call, and lifecycle identities are mandatory.

census.limits: TaskFlow and Agent events bind child identity; spans remain behavioral-only until product identity attributes exist.

redaction.rule: Persist structured IDs as fingerprints; never raw prompts, tokens, or transcripts.

controls.positive: Child flow and nonce-rendered reason agree.
controls.negative: A parent or unrelated child flow must not join.

verdictAuthority.pass: Child-bound behavior and raw topology are present.
verdictAuthority.partial: Telemetry or rebind prerequisites are unavailable.
verdictAuthority.fail: Child identity or hop-two behavior fails.

execution.deterministicK6: Live child producer captures structured identities.
execution.manual: Independent reviewer inspects TaskFlow and trace receipts.
execution.relationship: Structured child lineage controls sentinel interpretation.

liveRunSafety.notes: Fresh live child hop-two producer. Historical/static packets cannot satisfy this row.
